access_boundary: This record represents the o3 release identified by the dated snapshot o3-2025-04-16, announced April 2025. OpenAI announced its deprecation and documents the shutdown date of December 11, 2026 with GPT-5.6 Sol as the recommended replacement. The o3-mini and o3-pro siblings, the later GPT-5 family, the OpenAI platform, and ChatGPT remain separate product or service boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the pinned snapshot, deprecation date, and recommended replacement first-party
Reasoning behavior, image and PDF input, and structured outputs are documented
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Access ends at the documented shutdown date
